title: With every term deactivated, Active keeps the three fixed terms and the default
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have exactly two terms of the shop's own and no others: term A, due 14 days after the invoice date, and term B, due on the 10th of the following month.
  • Make sure term A is the default for new customers.
  • Make sure every term that can be switched off is deactivated: Net 7, Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120 and term B.
  • Start on the Credit Terms page (Settings, then "Credit Terms" in the Finance group), Active tab.
custom_steps:
1. Read the rows on the Active tab.
  2. Click the "Inactive" tab.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Active lists exactly COD, Due on Receipt, term A (with the Default tag) and Credit Hold, in that order, and its count reads 4.

Step 2:

  • Inactive lists Net 7, Net 15, Net 20, Net 30, Net 45, Net 50, Net 60, Net 90, Net 120 and term B, in that order, and its count reads 10.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11670 (Story 1, Credit Terms page and list)

  • S1-E1: “If every term that can be deactivated has been deactivated, the Active tab lists COD, Due on Receipt, Credit Hold and, when the default is another term, the default (it can't be deactivated, S2-N4). The Inactive tab lists everything else.”
  • S1-R3: “Below the header are two tabs, "Active" and "Inactive", each followed by a count of the terms in it. The page opens on Active.”
